features.name: Isolation Spins
features.description: Seven free spins with cells unlocked on the trigger reels.

review:
A prison break on an odd 2-3-4-4-4-4 six-reel layout, with four locked Enhancer Cells above the last four reels. A scatter opens a cell, revealing xSplit, xWays, sticky wilds, wild reels or doubled inmates.

Bonus symbols on reels 3 to 6 turn wild, and three of them start seven Isolation Spins with cells unlocked where they landed. Dense and busy – learn it in demo. Extreme volatility, 44,444x max, 96.1% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
